setup.sql: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS index_lab;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS index_lab.tx;

CREATE TABLE index_lab.tx
(
    id UInt64 CODEC(LZ4),
    msg String CODEC(LZ4),
    INDEX i_msg msg TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha)
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY id;

INSERT INTO index_lab.tx SELECT number, concat('GET /api/v1/item/', toString(number % 1000), ' status=', if(number % 1000003 = 0, '504 timeout', '200 ok'), ' user=u', toString(number % 100000)) FROM numbers(20000000);
OPTIMIZE TABLE index_lab.tx FINAL;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS index_lab.tx_bp;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS index_lab.tx_pfor;

CREATE TABLE index_lab.tx_bp
(
    id UInt64 CODEC(LZ4),
    msg String CODEC(LZ4),
    INDEX i_msg msg TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha, posting_list_codec = 'bitpacking')
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY id;
INSERT INTO index_lab.tx_bp SELECT * FROM index_lab.tx;
OPTIMIZE TABLE index_lab.tx_bp FINAL;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS index_lab.am_off;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS index_lab.am_t;

CREATE TABLE index_lab.am_off
(
    id UInt64 CODEC(LZ4),
    v UInt32 CODEC(LZ4),
    s String CODEC(LZ4),
    ts DateTime CODEC(LZ4)
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY id;

CREATE TABLE index_lab.am
(
    id UInt64 CODEC(LZ4),
    v UInt32 CODEC(LZ4),
    s String CODEC(LZ4),
    ts DateTime CODEC(LZ4)
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY id
SETTINGS add_minmax_index_for_numeric_columns = 1, add_minmax_index_for_string_columns = 1;
INSERT INTO index_lab.am_off SELECT number, intDiv(number, 10), leftPad(toString(intDiv(number, 1000)), 6, '0'), toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') + number FROM numbers(8192000);
OPTIMIZE TABLE index_lab.am_off FINAL;
INSERT INTO index_lab.am SELECT number, intDiv(number, 10), leftPad(toString(intDiv(number, 1000)), 6, '0'), toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') + number FROM numbers(8192000);
OPTIMIZE TABLE index_lab.am FINAL;

CREATE TABLE index_lab.am_t
(
    id UInt64 CODEC(LZ4),
    v UInt32 CODEC(LZ4),
    s String CODEC(LZ4),
    ts DateTime CODEC(LZ4)
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY id
SETTINGS add_minmax_index_for_temporal_columns = 1;
INSERT INTO index_lab.am_t SELECT number, intDiv(number, 10), leftPad(toString(intDiv(number, 1000)), 6, '0'), toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') + number FROM numbers(8192000);
OPTIMIZE TABLE index_lab.am_t FINAL;

setup.sql: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS index_lab;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS index_lab.big;

CREATE TABLE index_lab.big
(
    id UInt64 CODEC(LZ4),
    uid UInt64 CODEC(LZ4),
    v UInt32 CODEC(LZ4),
    msg String CODEC(LZ4),
    INDEX i_uid uid TYPE bloom_filter GRANULARITY 1,
    INDEX i_tok msg TYPE tokenbf_v1(32768, 3, 0) GRANULARITY 1
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY id;

INSERT INTO index_lab.big SELECT number, intHash64(number), intHash32(number) % 1000000, concat('GET /api/v1/item/', toString(number % 1000), ' status=', if(number % 1000003 = 0, '504 timeout', '200 ok'), ' user=u', toString(number % 100000)) FROM numbers(20000000);
OPTIMIZE TABLE index_lab.big FINAL;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS index_lab.big_lz4;

CREATE TABLE index_lab.big_lz4
(
    id UInt64 CODEC(LZ4),
    uid UInt64 CODEC(LZ4),
    v UInt32 CODEC(LZ4),
    msg String CODEC(LZ4),
    INDEX i_uid uid TYPE bloom_filter GRANULARITY 1,
    INDEX i_tok msg TYPE tokenbf_v1(32768, 3, 0) GRANULARITY 1
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY id
SETTINGS defa
INSERT INTO index_lab.big_lz4 SELECT * FROM index_lab.big;
OPTIMIZE TABLE index_lab.big_lz4 FINAL;
